title: KDE vs Xresources
body: After the 6.8.0 kde/plasma update, now opening xterm gives me a blank slate one. nothing in my xrdb until I manually load it up. I was using kde+wayland since forever and never had to do this manually. Anyone know if they removed anything that was loading this automatically? it worked very well and I would like to see what it was to put it in place again
